pcEvidence.meaning: AI2 loader constructs168-byte path,92-byte point and36-byte connection runtime records; distances, node bounds and routing rows.
PC writer maps runtime fields back to serialized AI2, corroborating exact fields.
Primary route next-connection lookup indexes matrix row, then point adjacency slot and returns direction.
Route distance follows stored next-hop indices, adds connection distance, returns FLT_MAX for no route/excluded mask; two-entry unrestricted cache and immediate repeated-edge stop.
Offline route distance build recursively visits graph; directed flag0x40000000 disables traversal; nonzero requested mask requires overlap with connection routeMask.
For each destination chooses strict-minimum candidate neighbor cost, writes adjacency-slot ordinal,255 default/diagonal.

limits: Native table interpretation confirmed; stored tables can reflect editor-time flags and do not establish complete gameplay pathfinding.
Route groups, capability masks, dynamic special updates, path-volume membership and collision interaction are not all reconstructed.
Decoded connections retain source numeric fields; new semantic aliases do not destroy evidence.
